scope: Bounded active lib deletion/re-auth lookup and twelve exact consumer/test/lock reads; no code, provider or UI execution

findings.finding: The only live member deletion transport calls the legacy request_account_deletion RPC as<void>, discards its UUID, and has no typed pending receipt/status/error mapping.

The member deletion screen confirms and submits selected reason labels, then sets a local submitted flag. Postgrest/session/conflict errors collapse into a generic connection retry message. It has no durable pending request identity, own-status query or fresh-auth action.

The existing OTP transport sends WhatsApp OTP and verifies it with the Supabase SDK. Its generic send permits default SDK user creation and its verify returns<void>, so a privacy-specific boundary must distinguish existing-subject sign-in and fence returned/adopted identity.
When a profile exists, /auth immediately redirects to next or /home. Navigating a signed-in member to the existing login route alone does not display fresh-auth verification.

The method named signInWithOtp performs profile hydration when currentUser exists; the actual OTP verification occurs in AuthScreen beforehand. Calling the repository method alone cannot establish a fresh Auth session.

Admin MFA transport/controller provides reusable await-time identity fencing and no-secret error patterns, but establishes AAL2 while preserving owner/SID. It is not proof of a new member session creation time and cannot replace the SQL ten-minute fence.
Admin login already uses shouldCreateUser:false for existing approved identities. Its operator approval/role logic must not be carried into an ordinary member request.

ownership: member OTP boundary and its tests
options.reuse: Auth OTP gateway/UI parts, CAPTCHA/environment handling, existing SID/generation fence pattern; ordinary member identity only
options.needed: Use trusted current Auth subject/phone, disallow account creation, fence identity across every await and response/adoption, explicit confirmation after verification, stable typed request UUID/reason, own pending/status model and safe allowlisted errors. Let SQL verify freshness; do not derive Auth.sessions.created_at from JWT iat or refresh timestamp.

options.option: Explicit logout and existing normal sign-in with guarded return
ownership: existing sign-out and post-auth target consumer
options.reuse: Normal AuthScreen verified OTP and safe next target after actual logout
options.needed: Retain only subject-bound minimal pending intent and exact UUID; clear on account switch/cancel/expiry, do not automatically resubmit a destructive request, check pending status before explicit retry, prove logout/new SID and identity fences. Existing provider/session side effects and profile disposal need review.

not_proof: No hosted OTP delivery or sign-in tested
No new SID issuance/fresh creation or SDK adoption race proven
No member fresh-auth/error UX or typed status model implemented
No legal scope or retention completion approval
